title: Black Sunday
body: The park opened on July 17, 1955, after about a year of construction on former orange groves. Opening day went badly. Counterfeit tickets roughly doubled the crowd, a plumbers' strike forced a choice between working toilets and drinking fountains (Walt picked toilets), and the fresh asphalt on the entrance street was soft enough in the heat to trap high heels. The staff called it Black Sunday. The park was fine by the following week.
